shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' package.json; sed -n '1,240p' next.config.ts; sed -n '1,280p' app/page.tsx; sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx; sed -n '1,240p' app/loading.tsx; sed -n '1,260p' app/RevenueChart.tsx; sed -n '1,260p' app/LatestInvoices.tsx; sed -n '1,260p' app/CardStats.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short; git log --oneline -5 --decorate; rg -n \"partial|prerender|Suspense|use cache|dashboard|shell\" . -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"'; find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -printf '%p\\n' | sort"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' __agent_eval__/run.mjs; git show HEAD:package.json; git show HEAD:app/page.tsx; git show HEAD:next.config.ts; git diff -- package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "find .next/server/app -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p %s bytes\\n' | sort; sed -n '1,240p' .next/server/app/index.html 2>/dev/null || true; rg -n \"Dashboard|Loading dashboard|PPR_BOUNDARY|Revenue|Latest\" .next/server/app .next/server -g '*.html' -g '*.rsc' -g '*.meta' -g '*.json' | sed -n '1,200p'"

/bin/bash -lc "find .next/server/chunks/ssr -type f -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 rg -l \"api\\.example\\.com/dashboard|Total Revenue\"; rg -n \"api\\.example\\.com/dashboard|Total Revenue|Latest Invoices\" .next/server/chunks/ssr -g '*.js' | sed -n '1,160p'"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,300p' app/page.tsx; git diff -- app/page.tsx tsconfig.json package.json"

/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check; git status --short; git diff --stat; git diff -- app/page.tsx; test ! -e .next && echo '"'build artifacts cleaned'; test "'! -e next-env.d.ts && echo '"'generated next-env.d.ts cleaned'"
